description: This file defines the InstallCommand class for Drupal, which manages the installation process of a Drupal site via CLI, including configuration, validation, and execution of installation steps.

classes.name: InstallCommand
classes.description: A Symfony Console command class for installing a Drupal site, including configuration, validation, and execution logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the command with a class loader.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command's name, description, arguments, options, and usage examples.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that checks environment, validates input, and triggers the installation process.

methods.name: isDrupalInstalled
methods.description: Checks if Drupal is already installed by booting the kernel and checking database connection info.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs the Drupal installation with specified profile, language, site name, recipe, and password.

methods.name: getSitePath
methods.description: Returns the site path, defaulting to 'sites/default' or environment variable override.

methods.name: selectProfile
methods.description: Prompts user to select an installation profile from available profiles.

methods.name: validateProfile
methods.description: Validates if a given profile name exists in available profiles.

methods.name: validateRecipe
methods.description: Validates if a given recipe directory and recipe.yml file exist.

methods.name: getProfiles
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available installation profiles, optionally including hidden profiles and auto-selecting distributions.
